paite: Bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, himhim nei in TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah na kithoih ding uh ahi kei. Hiai lah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in thilkihhuai ahi ngal a.
english: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Na lak uah TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na tenna koipeuh uah leng pasal hiam, numei hiam leng, thukhun bohsia a pathian dang nna va sem a,
english: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

paite: ka thupiak louh, ni hiam, kha hiam, van ate himhim hiam, TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih a-om a;
english: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,

paite: ahon hilh ua, nang na zak a, phatuamngaitak a na dot a, ngai in, adik a, thu atel mahmah a, huchibang thilkihhuai Israelte lak a hih ana hihleh;
english: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,

paite: huai thil gilou hihmi, pasal hiam, numei hiam na kulh kongkhak polam uah pasal hiam numei hiam pen na pikhe ding ua, suang in na denglum ding uhi.
english: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

paite: Theihpih nih hiam, thum hiam kam a pan in asi ding mi hihlup ding ahi. Himahleh theihpih khat kia kam a pan in hihlup ding ahi kei.
english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

paite: Hihlup ding pen tung ah theihpihte'n akhut uh that ding in akha masa ding ua, huai khit chiang in mipi tengteng in, huchibang in na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Sisan kisuah thu ah, sum-le-pai thu ah, kivuak thu ah, na tenna ua kiselna thu himhim a nou a dia vaihawm haksa lua ahong omleh, TOUPA na Pathian un amun seh ding ah na hoh ding ua,
english: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God chooses.

paite: huai hun a siampu Levite leh vaihawmte kiang a hoh in na dong ding uhi. Amau thu hihpukdan ding hon na kawkmuh ding uhi.
english: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

paite: Huchi in nou TOUPA'N mun aseh ding a pan thu hihpukdan hon na kawkmuh bang un na hih ding ua, ahon sinsak bang un pilvangtak in na hih ding uhi.
english: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.

paite: Thu hihpukdan hon na sinsak uleh vaihawmdan hon na hilh bang zel un na hih ding uhi. Thu hihpukdan hon na kawkmuh uh taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam na pialsan ding uh ahi kei.
english: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a nasem a pang siampu leh vaihawmmi thu pom lou a, engtat peuhmah, huai mi hihlup ding ahi. Israel a pan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Yahweh your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding ua, a-engtat nawn kei ding uhi.
english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding gam na va tun ua, na va luah ua, na va ten ua, "I gam a nam tengteng bang in kumpipa i nei ding uh, na chih chiang un,"
heading: Kumpipa Toh Kisai Thuhilhnate
english: When you have come to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un atel pen kumpipa dia na neih ding uh ahi. Na unau lak ua mi khat na kumpipa ding ua na bawl ding uh ahi. Namdangmi, na unau uh hilou zaw nou hon uk dia na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: you shall surely set him whom Yahweh your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

paite: Himahleh sakol tampi akaikhawm ding ahi kei, ahihkeileh sakol zong ding in Aigupta gam a kik nawn ding in mite asawl ding ahi kei. Aziak ahihleh TOUPA'N, "Huai lam a na kik nawn louh ding uh ahi," achi khinta hi.
english: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because Yahweh has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”

paite: Alungtang pimang a a-omlouhna ding in zi leng tampi aneih ding ahi kei. Dangka leh dangka-eng leng tampi akhawm ding ahi kei.
english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, alalgam laltutphah a atut chiang in siampu Levite a pan kila hiai dan teisawn a, amah a dia laibuzial a agelh ding ahi.
english: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.

paite: Hiai dan amah kiang ah a-om gige ding a, adamsung teng a, asim zel ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA a Pathian laudan asin thei dia, hiai dan thu tengteng leh dan thusehte pilvangtak in azui thei dia,
english: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;

paite: a-unaute tung ah alungtang akisathei kei dia, dan a pan taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah apial kei ding hi. Huai nung in alalgam Israel tung ah amah leh asuante'n sawtpi vai ahawm ding uhi.
english: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.
